title: PsiQuantum receives $150m conditional loan commitment from US gov't to expand manufacturing and prototyping efforts
source_used: The Next Web (original DCD page blocked, HTTP 403)
key_facts: PsiQuantum received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150 million from the US Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital, announced on Thursday 8 Oct 2026.
The money would go to PsiFactory, PsiQuantum's 140,000-square-foot hub in Milpitas, California, where it builds and tests prototypes of its planned fault-tolerant quantum computers.
It would pay for component and system test equipment, assembly and testing infrastructure, and advanced cryogenic systems.
PsiQuantum says the financing is not guaranteed; a final loan needs financial, legal, technical and regulatory conditions to be met.
It is the second conditional loan from the office in two days; Wolfspeed was offered up to $1.5bn on Wednesday.
In July PsiQuantum signed a $125 million expanded agreement with DARPA; in September it finalised a $100 million CHIPS Act award.
